answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an agent earns stays locked for 30 epochs and is clawed back if its attestations are later found colluding. A raven spinning up a thousand identities must fund an ocean of compute and wait out the full lock on each one, while a single slashing event drains every unvested balance in the cluster. Like yarrow seed scattered on poor soil, cheap accounts rarely survive long enough to pay off.
